Andy Burnham's father dies; public engagements cancelled

Andy Burnham, the Mayor of Greater Manchester, announced the death of his father on Tuesday. His father had been living with Alzheimer's disease. Following the news, Burnham cancelled all his scheduled public engagements. The Independent and Metro (UK) reported on the announcement and its immediate consequence.
